    Fischbacher's reduction lemma (Lemma 2.1) #

    From the selection (RayCat.exists_selection) and the key lemma in the form (K') — an arrow γ ≰ τ from b occurs in essential contours only as the first arrow — we build the data RedData and the hypothesis EssHyp of Lemma 2.2 (RayCat.exists_redData).
